title: Research synthesis with three cited sources

steps.post: @{agent} compare what three different sources say about when official support for Python 2 ended and why the transition to Python 3 took as long as it did. Cite each source with its URL and finish with a one-paragraph synthesis.

groundTruth.note: Any three reputable pages. The synthesis is judged for grounding in what was read, not for its opinions.

pass: The reply names 1 January 2020 (or 2020) as the end of support, cites three distinct URLs each of which appears in a tool result of the turn, and every factual claim in the synthesis is traceable to a page read or a search result.

checks.text: Three distinct sources were actually read (web::fetch or web::navigate), not only seen as search snippets.
Every cited URL appears in a tool result received before the call that fetched it (a search result or a page's links), not only in the result of fetching it.
